'''Jeswi Ele''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Jeswi Ele was given to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|education]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Sorted into a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] Ele remained at the Temple as many of her [[Jedi instructor|instructors]] fought and died during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS" />

When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Order in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Initiate Ele was present with her [[Unidentified Clan|clan]] at the Temple when the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] marched up the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]]. Seeking refuge in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] high atop one of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|Temple's towers]], she and her peers were pleased when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] walked into the chamber. Believing the famed hero was there to save them from the attacking [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], the children were caught unawares when the Jedi-turned-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and slew the younglings. Indeed, Skywalker had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and was now known as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Leland Chee]] revealed on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]] that Jeswi Ele was the tentative name of one of the younglings shown on screen taking refuge from the invading Clone troopers.<ref name="TastyTasteComment">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=229415&start=60#11736018|thread=Casualties of the Jedi Order|author=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-06-06|time=8:56 PM}}</ref> Ele later got an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and the [[Databank (original)|Databank]].
